138: I said no, but she kept trying to persuade me. I should think of it as publicity for my band. 243: Four authors have written the book they had always wanted to read. BØSSEDANMARK is a powerful collection of short stories about twenty different gay men's lives in twenty different places in Denmark. The book is published on 16 August 2021 during Copenhagen Pride. To mark its release, the authors will give a talk at Arnold Busck on Købmagergade on 15 August, from 2 to 4 pm. There will also be an open launch reception on 16 August at Bøssehuset in Christiania.
244: There are gay men everywhere in Denmark. Every little town has a few. Every block of flats. Every parish. From Copenhagen to Vester Skerninge. From Allinge to Hvide Sande.
